p: kings of Judah: By kings here and in other places are meant counsellors and governors of the people; who he calls the ancients, Jer 19:1.
tingle: Read of this phrase in 1Sa 3:11.
commanded not: By which is declared that whatever is not commanded by God's word concerning is service is against his word.
potter's vessel: This visible sign was to confirm them concerning the assurance of this plague, which the Lord threatened by his prophet.
houses upon whose: He notes the great rage of the idolaters who left no place free from their abominations, in that they polluted their own houses with it, as we see yet among the papists.
roofs they have burned incense to: Read De 22:8.
